name: Vsevolod Konstantinovich Freedericksz
summary: Russian physicist who founded the Russian school of liquid crystal physics and discovered the Freedericksz transition.

name: Charles Guye
summary: Swiss physicist known for work on electron mass and special relativity.

name: Woldemar Voigt
summary: German physicist who studied magnetic and electric fields on crystal structure.

name: David Hilbert
summary: German mathematician interested in physics and general theory of relativity.

name: Alexandra Nikolaevna Repieva
summary: Collaborator of Freedericksz on liquid crystal magnetic field studies.

name: Valentina Vasil'evna Zolina
summary: Collaborator of Freedericksz on Freedericksz equation derivation.

name: Victor Nikolaevich Tsvetkov
summary: Graduate student of Freedericksz and author of this biographical essay.

name: Maria Dmitrievna Shostakovich
summary: Wife of Freedericksz and elder sister of composer Dmitri Shostakovich.

name: Alexander Aleksandrovich Friedmann
summary: Russian physicist and author of the theory of an expanding universe.

name: University of Geneva
summary: Swiss university where Freedericksz obtained his doctoral degree.

name: University of Göttingen
summary: German university where Freedericksz worked with Voigt and Hilbert.

name: Leningrad State University
summary: Russian university where Freedericksz worked as assistant professor and continued LC studies.

name: Institute of Technical Physics
summary: Research institute where Freedericksz started liquid crystal studies in 1923.

name: Warsaw
summary: City in Poland where Freedericksz was born.

name: Leningrad
summary: City in Russia where Freedericksz worked for most of his career.

name: Freedericksz's equation
summary: Equation describing the threshold magnetic field for nematic liquid crystal reorientation.

name: Freedericksz medal
summary: Prize instituted by the Russian Liquid Crystal Society for achievements in LC science.
